content.comment_body: I'm using [product_name] with [version_no]. I've added an on-delay function, but it's not working on the physical device. Interestingly, it operates as expected in the simulation. I've faced this issue before, but this time I can't find a workaround.
Please share your program so we can check if all connections are properly set up.

I'll upload the program when I have access to my laptop again. I was short on time and ended up separating and rewriting the entire sequence to fix it. However, it's quite odd that it works in the simulation but not on the actual device. Has anyone else encountered this issue with [product_name]?

analysis.insight_summary: A user describes an issue where the on-delay function works during simulation but fails on the actual device. Past experiences have shown similar problems, often requiring significant changes to the program. There is concern that simulation results may not reliably represent performance on real hardware.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the on-delay function to behave consistently on both the real device and in simulation, without needing additional troubleshooting or significant changes to the program.
